List the markets of a Kalshi event

Source: R/kalshi.R
ks_markets.Rd

Kalshi organizes contracts as series (e.g. "PRES"), events (one occurrence, e.g. "PRES-2024"), and markets (one binary contract per outcome, e.g. "PRES-2024-DJT"). ks_markets() lists the markets of an event from both the live and the historical (settled) endpoints of the public API; ks_events() lists the events of a series.

Usage

ks_markets(event_ticker)

ks_events(series_ticker)

Arguments

event_ticker

Character, the event ticker.

series_ticker

Character, the series ticker (e.g. "PRES", "KXFEDDECISION").

Value

A tibble with columns ticker, event_ticker, title, outcome (Kalshi's yes_sub_title), status, open_time, close_time, and result.

ks_events(): a tibble with columns event_ticker, series_ticker, title, and sub_title.

See also

ks_prices()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ks_events("PRES")
ks_markets("PRES-2024")
} # }
